title: EvaluationContract v2
description: Adapter-layer exchange type: the evaluation contract derived from one case payload — the evidence category and maturity rung each claim type needs for promotion, the forbidden evidence channels, and case-specific checkpoints. v2 adds two binding surfaces (ADR-0008 addendum A3): study_id lets the consuming adapter fail closed when a claim or evidence item names a different study, and assessment_declaration carries the case's advance-declared evaluation dimensions so the adapter can compare declaration against the assessment evidence actually supplied. v1 stays frozen for the math/quant producers; a producer needing the binding surface emits v2. case_sha256 binds the exact case payload the contract was derived from. The contract's own canonical hash can be pinned into core evidence inputs (kind="config", sha256 required) so 'which contract judged this' stays auditable; the contract itself is an exchange type and never enters the store.

case_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the case payload this contract was derived from. Hash binding, not a locator.

study_id.description: Study the case (and therefore this contract) belongs to; consumers fail closed when a claim or an evidence item names a different study.

min_maturity.description: Minimum governance ladder rung the evidence supporting this claim type must reach inside this case.

required_evidence.description: Per-claim-type promotion requirements for this case. A contract with no requirements evaluates nothing.

forbidden_channels.description: Evidence channels that must never support promotion in this case (for example numeric-extrapolation-as-proof, future-function features, non-PIT data, misaligned labels). Required; write an explicit empty array only after consideration.

checkpoints.description: Case-specific checkpoint list (for example gate identifiers with their freeze assertions). Required; may be an explicit empty array.

dimension.description: Evaluation dimension the case declared in advance (for example a calibration, subgroup, robustness, or audit dimension). Free-form: the seam schema fixes no domain vocabulary.

status.description: Whether the dimension's evaluation is declared as planned or explicitly not performed.

detail.description: Method/key detail of the declaration (for example the declared probe or grouping key). Optional at the schema layer; 'declared implies detail present' is a consumer-side semantic obligation.

assessment_declaration.description: Evaluation dimensions the case declared in advance. Required; an explicit empty array declares no assessment dimensions. Declared-is-the-floor: consumers compare this declaration against the evidence actually supplied and fail closed on contradiction (evidence present for a dimension declared not_performed).
